clock_control.method: pinned on the Proxmox host (ssh epyc, root)

method: suite replay on gfx1201, 60 s sustained warmup, 15 repetitions, min-of-reps (per-rep spread recorded); ctx 2k-64k, q 1/2/4/8 (decode) 16/32/64 (prefill), b 1/2/4/8
reproducibility: two independent runs of the same points agreed within 0.4 % on the minimum
notes: Real device timings under pinned clocks. min_us is the estimator; median_us and spread show per-repetition jitter.
